”  Indeed, China’s space program — while still not as developed as the U.S.’s — is formidable, and Chinese officials have voiced a desire to surpass the United States’ capabilities by 2045. As of 2023, there were a total of 5,465 satellites in orbit around Earth, with the U.S. operating 3,433 (63%). China, by contrast, controls 541.
